ev.q: SnowRunner has the player control off-road vehicles as they traverse locations
an off-roading open world simulation video game
Mechanical improvements to trucks usually require the player to reach a certain progress threshold
SnowRunner has a large selection of trucks
Every location is in a rural region in either North America, Russia, Europe or Central Asia
Some critics praised the visuals and pacing of the game
completing construction projects and/or repairs at different locations
